issue.title: Greenfield readiness checklist: per-row detect + Fix (extend DiagnosticsPanel)

successCriteria.description: The checklist detects and displays each readiness row (framework / state / git repo / remote / gh auth / .gitignore) with pass/fix state for a blank folder.
Each fixable row has its own Fix action that runs and re-checks (per-row, not a single panel button).
Auth / remote-create rows hand off to the terminal (writeToActiveTerminal), not Rust.

phases.title: check_greenfield_readiness Tauri command + GreenfieldReport
phases.content: Add a NEW Tauri command `check_greenfield_readiness(project_path: String) -> Result<GreenfieldReport, String>` (this belongs to #284, NOT #283). Define `GreenfieldReport` with serde camelCase booleans: frameworkInstalled (read_framework_version returns Some), stateSeeded (project/.tiki/state.json exists), isGitRepo (project/.git exists or get_current_branch Ok), hasRemote (git_remote_get returns Some — git_remote_get shipped in #283), ghAuthenticated (check_gh_auth Ok(true)), hasGitignore (project/.gitignore exists). It MUST work on a BLANK folder — return an all-false report, NEVER Err for a degraded/empty folder (mirror tiki_doctor's degraded-not-Err discipline, commands.rs:851). Compose existing detectors: check_gh_auth (github/auth.rs:131 — Err/false => not authed), read_framework_version (commands.rs:837), git_remote_get (github/git.rs, #283). Register in lib.rs generate_handler!. Tests: blank temp dir => all-false, no Err; dir with .tiki/state.json + .framework-version => stateSeeded + frameworkInstalled true; a git-init'd dir => isGitRepo true.
verification: cargo test --lib passes incl. greenfield readiness tests (blank folder => all-false report, no Err)
check_greenfield_readiness registered in lib.rs and callable
phases.summary: check_greenfield_readiness Tauri cmd + GreenfieldReport (camelCase, degraded-not-Err, composes read_framework_version/git_remote_get/check_gh_auth/.git/.gitignore/state.json) + registered; +3 tests; cargo test --lib 88→91; clippy clean

phases.title: greenfieldReadiness.ts pure reducer + tests
phases.content: Add apps/desktop/src/utils/greenfieldReadiness.ts: a TS interface GreenfieldReport mirroring the Rust struct (camelCase booleans); a GreenfieldAction string-literal union 'installFramework' | 'seedState' | 'gitInit' | 'createGitignore' | 'ghAuthLogin' | 'createRemote'; a GreenfieldRow type { id, label, status: 'pass' | 'fix', action?: GreenfieldAction, handoff?: boolean }; and a PURE reducer greenfieldReadiness(report): GreenfieldRow[] mapping each report field to a row (pass when true; fix + the matching action when false; mark ghAuthLogin/createRemote rows handoff:true). Avoid inline ?? [] / ?? {} (fresh-ref ESLint rule #279) — use module-level EMPTY_* consts. Add apps/desktop/src/utils/__tests__/greenfieldReadiness.test.ts mirroring diagnosticsSummary.test.ts: all-false report => every row 'fix' with the correct action; all-true report => every row 'pass', no actions.
verification: pnpm -C apps/desktop test passes incl. greenfieldReadiness reducer tests
pnpm -C apps/desktop lint clean (no new fresh-ref/exhaustive-deps errors)
phases.summary: greenfieldReadiness.ts pure reducer (GreenfieldReport/GreenfieldAction/GreenfieldRow; 6 rows pass|fix+action, handoff for remote/ghAuth) + 5 tests; vitest 267→272; tsc-b clean; lint 0 new

phases.title: GreenfieldChecklist component (per-row Fix) + Settings mount
phases.content: Add apps/desktop/src/components/settings/GreenfieldChecklist.tsx + .css, cloning the DiagnosticsPanel load state-machine (useState report/loading/error; useCallback load => invoke('check_greenfield_readiness', { projectPath: activeProject.path }); useEffect) but rendering each GreenfieldRow with an INLINE per-row Fix button (model: ProjectCard.tsx:26-51 runInstall + a per-row pending guard in component useState (Set/Record) + toast + re-run load() after). Per-row Fix dispatch (switch on row.action): installFramework => invoke('install_framework', {projectPath}); seedState => invoke('init_tiki_project', {projectPath}) (idempotent); gitInit => invoke('git_init', {projectPath}); createGitignore => invoke('init_tiki_project', {projectPath}) (it writes the .gitignore); ghAuthLogin => writeToActiveTerminal('gh auth login\n') + setActiveView('terminal'); createRemote => writeToActiveTerminal('gh repo create\n'). After Rust-invoke fixes: await load() to re-check (SC2). For terminal-handoff rows: show a 'run in the terminal, then Re-check' hint + a manual Refresh (no auto-detect of interactive completion). Handle writeToActiveTerminal returning null (no terminal) => toast 'Open a terminal first'. Mount GreenfieldChecklist in the Settings view next to DiagnosticsPanel (find the file that renders DiagnosticsPanel). Keep ALL per-row pending state in component useState (never a store selector => no fresh-ref). Pass raw projectPath (do NOT string-build a .tiki path in TS — a blank folder has no .tiki).
verification: GreenfieldChecklist mounted in Settings; renders one row per readiness item with a per-row Fix button (VISUAL SC1/SC2/SC3 — final confirm in tauri:dev: blank folder shows fix rows; Rust fixes mutate + recheck; auth/remote rows write to the terminal)
phases.summary: GreenfieldChecklist.tsx+.css (per-row Fix: install/init/git_init invokes + gh auth/repo terminal handoff via local writeToActiveTerminal, manual Re-check) mounted in SettingsPage next to DiagnosticsPanel; build clean, vitest 272, lint 0 new.
